name: Merciful Channeling (General)
body:
You can infuse your channeled energy with the power of your mercies.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, channel positive energy class feature, mercy class feature.

Benefit(s): When you use your channel energy ability to heal living creatures, they also receive the benefits of your mercies.
